label: Worldwise deletion and a necessary concretum are incompatible (inference)
rule: Apply deletion at w to the necessary concretum's witness
meaning: Given worldwise deletion on a profile's Ontic and concreteness predicate and a concrete x existing at w and at every world accessible from w, deletion at w gives an accessible world u lacking x, while x exists at u. A premise-free certificate of the incompatibility recorded by the attacks relation e8a48d7f; it decides neither statement.
